item.subject: maths
item.stem: Yash measures the heights of three plants as $12$ cm, $18$ cm, and $9$ cm. The graph shows the display he is planning for plants A, B, and C.

options.A: Call the finished picture a vertical column label only.
options.B: Say that choosing upward columns is what creates the three plant heights $12$, $18$, and $9$.
options.C: Use upward columns so taller plants read as taller bars, matching how height is measured.
options.D: Pick the largest printed number $18$ alone and treat that single number as the finished display.
